clauses.rationale: Standalone representations do not become Definition artifacts by themselves. Rich artifacts containing quotations or ontology links are not excluded.
Independent classification axes require model-pair/non-entailment contracts and canonical value/coupling semantics. Different nominal sorts alone do not prove independence.
No-inference between canonical fields is a policy/evidence obligation; no arbitrary negated implication is assumed in T.
A declared axis dependence must have an explicit typed axis relation. Actual admitted Relation Kind/endpoint/qualifier/owner validity is not established by this primitive predicate.
Convenience labels are generated projections; generation does not imply normative authority.

findings.description: Formal biconditional names ten attributes; prose necessary conditions also require applicability, exclusions and primary consumers. Both are encoded, so the combined theory forces the extra attributes whenever the ten formal attributes hold. This consequence requires source-owner resolution; no field is silently dropped.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner must decide whether to expand the formal expression, clarify shorthand, or revise the prose in a new authoritative version.

findings.description: One normative meaning is interpreted per exact version, term and scope. Historical versions may differ in meaning; a global timeless term-to-meaning function would prohibit legitimate semantic successors.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner must confirm per-version uniqueness and the scope of active/current lookup uniqueness.

findings.description: Object admission, admitted source posture, schema validity, evidence, exact promotion and canonical authority remain distinct. Non-entailment clauses are separate witness requirements; causal promotion behavior and live source posture are not inferred from the static model.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner must bind admission/promotion meanings and exact real review decisions separately from source provenance.

findings.description: Typed axes and generic-record model pairs expose lack of automatic inference. Actual allowed canonical values, governed typed dependencies and universal independence claims remain outside the primitive projection.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and Classification/Typed Relation owners must review exact value/coupling contracts and inferential scope.
